rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal heat-pump behaviour and the contributing factors (cold garage, door opening, low spin speed, full load). It asked the key question about dry clothes early and recommended no parts. Weaknesses: the odd opening 'switch it off and unplug it', and it repeated the load and spin advice across turns. It also told the customer to rinse an already-clean filter and said the full drum was 'very likely a big part' before knowing about the garage, which is mildly overconfident. Escalation to the manufacturer under warranty was appropriately conditional on a fault being shown.
